name: Largo
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Largo, FL 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Largo, Florida for 2026: holiday train rides, Santa visits, a tree lighting and a parade, with dates and prices checked.
lede: Largo turns Largo Central Park into a lights display with carnival rides, a holiday train and a tree lighting, and adds Santa visits, a downtown parade and a heritage village stop.
celebrates: The City of Largo's Recreation, Parks and Arts department anchors the season at Largo Central Park, where more than two million LED lights, carnival rides, food and market vendors fill the evenings from November 26 to January 3, according to the city. The Largo Central Railroad adds the Rudolph Limited holiday train ride on three weekends, and a tree lighting on December 5 brings Santa photos. The city also runs a pajama party with Santa, a sensory-friendly Santa visit with a signing Santa, and Santa's Calling by phone, while the Rotary Club of Largo presents the downtown parade.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap for Largo's holiday events, so this page leans on the city's own 2026 guide. That guide calls the Holiday Lights a beloved Largo tradition that returns each year and calls the Rudolph Limited a beloved annual holiday tradition at the Largo Central Railroad. The Rotary Club of Largo's parade is described as its annual Old Fashioned Christmas Parade.
facts: The Largo Central Railroad runs miniature trains through Largo Central Park, and the city's Rudolph Limited page uses the slogan Christmas on the Route of Progress. Ulmer Park, the site of the Sensitive and Signing Santa, sits in downtown Largo at 301 West Bay Drive, the city says. The city's holiday guide also lists a Christmas Poetry Walk at McGough Nature Park on December 19, where Christmas-themed poetry is displayed along the trails.
trains: Largo has its own holiday train. The Rudolph Limited at the Largo Central Railroad runs December 11 to 13, 18 to 20 and 26 and 27, 2026, and tickets are $12 per person at the park, according to the City of Largo. For more rail history, the Florida Railroad Museum in Parrish and the Henry B. Plant Museum in Tampa are both listed on our museum guide.
train_links: A heritage railroad museum south of Tampa Bay, listed on our museum guide.

traditions: More than two million LED lights fill Largo Central Park nightly from November 26 to January 3, with rides at $6 each.
A holiday train ride on the Largo Central Railroad, $12 per person.
The city's December 5 tree lighting with live entertainment and Santa photos.

kidfact: Largo's holiday train rides through glowing tunnels and across sparkling bridges, and every rider needs a ticket.
faq: The city lights Largo Central Park with more than two million LED lights, adds carnival rides and a holiday train called the Rudolph Limited, and holds a tree lighting on December 5. Downtown hosts an Old Fashioned Christmas Parade on December 19, presented by the Rotary Club of Largo.
Is there a holiday train ride in Largo?
Yes. The Rudolph Limited at the Largo Central Railroad runs December 11 to 13, 18 to 20 and 26 and 27, 2026, and costs $12 per person, with tickets sold at the event only.
Are the Largo Holiday Lights free?
The city says the lights are free to walk, parking is free every night except December 5, and rides cost $6 each or $50 for 10.
Where can kids meet Santa in Largo?

Santa appears at the December 5 tree lighting, Tail Waggin' Pics with Santa on December 10, PJs and Pizza with Santa on December 12, Sensitive and Signing Santa on December 17 and Santa Saturday at Heritage Village on December 19.
Is there a sensory-friendly Santa in Largo?
Yes. The city's Sensitive and Signing Santa is free on December 17 at Ulmer Park, with sensory zones, therapy dogs and a Santa who signs.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Largo for 2026, and here is what he found: 14 family events, 6 of them free. The magic runs from November 26 (Holiday Lights and Carnival Rides in Largo Central Park) through January 3, 2027 (the Holiday Lights), with the Holiday Tree Lighting and Stroll (December 5), the Holiday Concert in the Park (December 12), the Rudolph Limited Holiday Train Ride (December 11 to 27) and the Largo Old Fashioned Christmas Parade (December 19) along the way, plus Belleair Bluffs' tree lighting (December 4) and Christmas at the Farm at DK Farms and Gardens (November 28 to December 26). We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Largo

  • 14 Christmas events for kids in Largo
  • 6 free events, including Holiday Lights and Carnival Rides, Holiday Lights in the Gardens, the Holiday Tree Lighting and Stroll, Belleair Bluffs' Tree Lighting, Sensitive and Signing Santa and the Old Fashioned Christmas Parade
  • Meet Santa: the tree lighting (December 5), Tail Waggin' Pics (December 10), PJs and Pizza (December 12), Sensitive and Signing Santa (December 17) and Santa Saturday at Heritage Village (December 19) and the Belleair Bluffs tree lighting (December 4)
  • Parades, tree lightings and music: Holiday Tree Lighting and Stroll (December 5), the Holiday Concert in the Park (December 12) and the Largo Old Fashioned Christmas Parade (December 19); the Belleair Bluffs Tree Lighting (December 4)
  • Trains: the Rudolph Limited Holiday Train Ride at the Largo Central Railroad (December 11 to 13, 18 to 20 and 26 and 27)
  • Season: November 26 to January 3, 2027
